description: This Java class 'SetTimerActivity' is part of an Android application for wearable devices. It provides UI and logic to set a timer, either through predefined options or via an intent with a specified duration. It manages notification setup, alarm registration, and interaction with wearable list views.

classes.name: SetTimerActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for setting timers, handling user interactions, notifications, and alarm scheduling on Android Wear.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, processes intent extras, sets up timer options, and UI layout.

methods.name: setupTimer
methods.description: Configures and starts the timer, shows notification, and sets alarm.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles user click on list items to set corresponding timer durations.

methods.name: onTopEmptyRegionClick
methods.description: Empty handler for clicks on empty list region; no action taken.

methods.name: registerWithAlarmManager
methods.description: Sets up the system alarm to trigger when timer expires.

methods.name: buildNotification
methods.description: Constructs and returns a notification displaying the countdown, with actions to restart or delete the timer.
